summary: Independent checks recovered all 179 gene identities in Figure 13A without using endpoint values. Of 170 genes shared with the registered week-12 versus day-0 result, 156 had a determinate direction: 147 agreed (94.23%) and nine were opposite. The proposal passed validation as a reconstructed, selected-gene comparison. [Publisher article](https://doi.org/10.1587/nolta.17.186)
openIssues: Fourteen paired directions remain indeterminate at the figure’s color resolution. Nine plotted genes have no registered DE row.

The figure reports expression in gene-specific standard-deviation units. Author-fitted endpoint log2 fold changes, P values and FDR remain unavailable. The evidence supports neither a direct-effect comparison spec nor full verification.
The linked GakuNin RDM project requires institutional sign-in, so its file inventory remains unknown.
